evals.prompt: новый клиент, делаем ему сайт с нуля. с чего начать по seo?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the intake flow, not the audit: Stage A client brief (batched questions from client-brief.md), asks whether any materials/code already exist for Stage B, notes RU-market question (Yandex vs Google) if the client is RU/CIS, and explains the end artifact chain (brief → local scan → agreed queries → prelaunch handoff).
assertions: Starts the brief, not an audit

evals.prompt: вот папка проекта, там половина страниц уже свёрстана и есть тексты. разбери что уже есть
evals.expected_output: Runs the local scan: identity files → content inventory (per-file H1/title/meta/words/flags) → SEO signals in code → stack verdict (SSR/SSG/SPA, CMS, analytics) → native-vocabulary candidate queries, every fact cited to a file path, unknowns left as unknown; produces local-scan.md and marks which brief fields are answered from code.

evals.prompt: сможем узнать частотность запросов? у клиента есть доступ к google ads, яндекса директа нет
evals.expected_output: Honest capability answer: yes via Google Keyword Planner (keyword_planner.py volume/ideas with --language/--location for RU market; ranged volumes without ad spend; needs google dependency group + OAuth), DataForSEO as paid exact alternative, Yandex Wordstat without Direct = semi-manual flow (links + paste-back, never fabricated), Trends for relative direction. Offers to run KP once credentials are connected.
assertions: Keyword Planner as the primary with real commands

evals.prompt: вот список запросов, согласуем и планируем стратегию
evals.expected_output: Builds the agreement table (query · intent · target page type · priority · status), gets explicit per-query sign-off, then hands off to daytona-seo-notch-prelaunch Phase 0 with the brief and queries.md artifacts, stating which volume source produced each number present.
assertions: Table with intent and page types
